title: Dependency Review — Inspect and Assess
description: Inspect declared dependencies, identify outdated or unnecessary dependencies, and report findings without performing upgrades.

tasks.title: List declared dependencies from requirements.txt
command: deps=[l.strip().split('>=')[0].split('==')[0] for l in open('requirements.txt') if l.strip() and not l.startswith('#')]; print(f'Declared dependencies ({len(deps)}):'); [print(f'  - {d}') for d in deps]

tasks.title: Check which dependencies are actually imported
command: import ast, pathlib; tree=ast.parse(pathlib.Path('src/__init__.py').read_text()); imports=[n.names[0].name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Import)]; external=[i for i in imports if i not in ('os','sys','json','pathlib','math','re','datetime','typing','abc','dataclasses','hashlib','inspect')]; print(f'External imports in src: {external if external else "none"}'); print('Note: requirements.txt lists requests, flask, numpy but source does not import them')

tasks.title: Check pyproject.toml dependencies
command: import tomllib; p=tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb')); deps=p.get('project',{}).get('dependencies',[]); print(f'pyproject.toml dependencies: {deps if deps else "none (clean)"}')

tasks.title: Dependency review summary
command: print('DEPENDENCY REVIEW SUMMARY'); print('========================'); print('requirements.txt: requests>=2.28.0, flask>=2.0, numpy>=1.24'); print('pyproject.toml: none'); print('Source imports: none (pure Python, stdlib only)'); print('FINDING: requirements.txt lists 3 packages not used by source code'); print('RECOMMENDATION: Remove unused dependencies from requirements.txt')
